# FounderFits

> FounderFits is a parody costume and accessories store. The brand is a joke about startup culture; the products and orders are real.

## Products

### Barefoot Tech CEO Costume shoe covers

- What it is: oversized vinyl covers shaped like bare feet, a parody costume accessory worn over your shoes
- Included: one free-size pair; shoes only, outfit not included
- Size and fit: free size; no dimensions or weight are published
- Price: $24.99 USD
- Buy: https://shop.founderfits.com/products/barefoot-tech-ceo-costume-slippers-halloween-prank-feet

### Stealth Mode Founder Costume turtleneck

- What it is: a black long-sleeve turtleneck, a parody "founder uniform" costume piece
- Color and sizes: black; S, M, L, XL and 2XL; slim fit
- Material: knit fabric, polyester and wool
- Fit note: Asian sizing can run 1-2 sizes smaller than US sizes; if between sizes, take the larger one
- Included: one turtleneck; jeans, sneakers and the startup not included
- Price: $34.99 USD
- Buy: https://shop.founderfits.com/products/stealth-mode-founder-costume-turtleneck

## Halloween costume ideas

Two ideas: the shoe covers ($24.99), worn over the shoes you already have on, and the turtleneck ($34.99), a black "founder uniform". Both ship to the US only with an estimated delivery of 5-11 business days, so order early.

## Shipping and returns (both products)

- Ships to the United States only: https://shop.founderfits.com/policies/shipping-policy
- Estimated delivery time: typically 5-11 business days (an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival date)
- Returns: 30 days from delivery; items must be unused, unworn and in original packaging; worn costume items are not returnable; the buyer pays return shipping for change-of-mind returns: https://shop.founderfits.com/policies/refund-policy
